statement.zh: **攻击**：回旋镖攻击（Boomerang Attack）。回旋镖攻击把密码分成 E0 和 E1 两半，使用 E0 的高概率差分和 E1^{-1} 的高概率差分构造四元组 P、P′、Q、Q′；前三个差分成立时，Q、Q′ 会以较高概率满足 E0^{-1} 的差分。
statement.en: **Attack**: Boomerang Attack (回旋镖攻击).The boomerang attack splits the cipher into E0 and E1 and uses a high-probability differential for E0 and one for E1^{-1} to build a quartet P, P′, Q, Q′; when the first three differentials hold, Q and Q′ satisfy the E0^{-1} differential with high probability.

statement.zh: 整个密码可能没有高概率差分，但两个短差分可以分别有较高概率，因此回旋镖能击败`整体差分概率低就安全`的经验法则。按“输入 → 状态 → 变换 → 输出 → 判据”复述机制；每一步都要能指出谁执行、改变什么、留下什么证据。无法指出证据的步骤，只能标为待核，不能写成已复现。
statement.en:
The whole cipher may have no high-probability differential, while two short differentials can each have high probability, so the boomerang attack defeats the folk theorem that a low whole-cipher differential probability implies security.### Mechanism check

Restate the chain as input → state → transform → output → criterion.

statement.zh: 论文用 2^16 个自适应选择文本和 2^38 工作量攻破 COCONUT98，还给出 Khufu-16 的 2^18 个自适应选择文本、FEAL-6 的 4 个自适应选择明文/密文，以及 inside-out 对偶攻击对 CAST-256 16 轮的 2^49.3 个已知文本攻击。
statement.en: The paper breaks COCONUT98 with 2^16 adaptively chosen texts and 2^38 work, and also gives Khufu-16 with 2^18 adaptively chosen texts, FEAL-6 with 4 adaptively chosen plaintext/ciphertext queries, and an inside-out dual attack on 16-round CAST-256 with 2^49.3 known texts.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 攻击需要构造四元组，并具备自适应选择明文和密文的能力；数据和时间复杂度取决于两个短差分的概率，不能对所有分组密码通用。
statement.en:
The attack requires constructing quartets and the ability to obtain adaptively chosen plaintexts and ciphertexts; data and time complexity depend on the probabilities of the two short differentials and are not universal for all block ciphers.### Formal model

Adv_A = Pr[Succ_A] − Pr[Succ_ideal]；Cost = D × T × M；Success = 1[advantage > threshold].

statement.zh:
Wagner 在 1999 年 FSE 论文中提出回旋镖攻击，并用它说明仅消除整体高概率差分不足以保证差分安全性。给定抽象输入 x₀ 与参数 p，按模型得到 y₀，再用判据检查 y₀；这是推理示例，不是实测向量。若输入越出定义域、参数/密钥复用、实现偏离规范或版本不匹配，模型结论不再成立。「回旋镖攻击」按 攻击 的 A 级门槛复核：正文给出可复述的输入、状态、变换、输出与失败判据，示例只作推理演示，计算记录或“不适用”理由单独登记；来源、图、claim 和复核 hash 均绑定到当前内容。读者若发现参数、版本或来源不一致，应把该条退回“未核”，而不是用相邻条目的结论补齐。### 判据可执行性

Wagner introduced the boomerang attack in his 1999 FSE paper and used it to show that eliminating high-probability whole-cipher differentials is not enough to guarantee differential security.### Example and failure boundary
